fields.options:
Configurer TWINT — le certificat et les identifiants sont délivrés sur le portail marchand TWINT :
  1. Connectez-vous au portail marchand TWINT (bouton en haut à droite) et ouvrez votre boutique.
  2. Générez / téléchargez le certificat (.p12) et notez son mot de passe.
  3. Copiez le Store UUID — menu du portail COMMERCES → Commerce en ligne, éditez la boutique.
  4. Remplissez les champs ci-dessous, téléversez le .p12 dans Certificat P12, puis Enregistrez.

fields.label: Merchant UUID
fields.description: Auto-filled from the certificate file name when you attach the .p12 below — you normally don't type it. Stable identifier = the .p12 file name on neoservice (/home/neoffice/twint-certs/<merchant_uuid>.p12).

fields.label: TWINT Store UUID
fields.description: Store UUID provided by TWINT. Find it in the TWINT merchant portal → menu COMMERCES → Commerce en ligne → edit the store.

fields.label: P12 Password
fields.description: Password protecting the P12 certificate file stored on neoservice

fields.label: P12 Certificate
fields.description: Generate / download this .p12 on the TWINT merchant portal, then upload it here. On save it is pushed to neoservice and removed from this instance (the certificate lives only on neoservice). Re-upload to rotate it.

fields.label: Certificate Deployed
fields.description: Checked automatically once the P12 has been stored on neoservice.

fields.label: Certificate Expires On
fields.description: Read automatically from the certificate. A reminder email is sent and a POS warning shows in the 45 days before this date.

fields.label: Linked Payment Provider
fields.description: Payment Provider record that uses this Twint Settings as credentials source
